summary: The SBI General Livestock Policy document outlines the insurance agreement between SBI General Insurance and the insured for livestock coverage. It includes definitions of key terms, base coverage for livestock death due to specified perils, optional add-on covers (PTD, theft, transit, waivers), general exclusions, and detailed general conditions covering policy validity, claims, cancellation, subrogation, and grievance redressal. The document also specifies claims procedures, required documents, and escalation steps for complaints.
